<!-- Poker Chips App - Expo React Native -->
<!-- Uses Expo Router, TypeScript, and local game state management -->
<!-- Run with `npx expo start` and test on Expo Go -->
- This is a React Native Expo project using SDK 52 and Expo Router
- TypeScript is used throughout
- Game state is managed via React Context (src/GameContext.tsx)
- Core poker logic lives in src/gameState.ts
- All screens are in the app/ directory using file-based routing
- Theme constants are in src/theme.ts
